app.name: Hawker Hunt
app.tagline: Turn every hawker centre into your food hunting ground
app.subTagline: No download needed — scan and play

install.iosBody: Tap the Share icon below, then choose "Add to Home Screen"
install.iosStep3: Confirm — then launch it from your home screen

onboarding.step1Title: Walk to your nearest hawker centre
onboarding.step1Body: Open the map and find the closest hawker centre outpost
onboarding.step2Body: Open the map, get within 50m of an outpost and scan to check in—spirits roam nearby
onboarding.step3Body: Open the AR camera and catch food spirits with virtual chopsticks
onboarding.step4Body: Feed and pet them, gather materials to evolve, and spar at outposts
onboarding.g1: Stand straight, young one! Welcome to the Lion City food hunting ground.
onboarding.g2: Food spirits hide in every hawker centre on the island. To catch them, you must master my Chopstick Kung Fu!
onboarding.g3: Enough talk—I brought an Oily Rice Chick for you to practise on. Watch closely!
onboarding.aimHint: Tap the spirit the moment the gold ring shrinks onto the red ring!
onboarding.aimMiss1: Missed! No rush—wait for the gold ring to touch the red one.
onboarding.aimMiss2: Too hasty, young one. Watch the ring!
onboarding.mashHint: Once clamped it will struggle! Keep tapping to tighten your grip—don't let it slip!
onboarding.g4: Not bad, young one. Remember: strike on time, then tap like mad.
onboarding.g5: Spirits won't deliver themselves—get out there, young one!

auth.welcome: Welcome to the food hunting ground!
auth.terms: By signing up you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

Treat us to supper if you catch it~
